INSERT INTO task (name, kind, writer, schedule, window_dates, window_start,
            window_end, per_window, template_id, template_subject, template_body_md,
            model_config_id, state, created_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'active', ?)
        RETURNING id AS "id!"
